name: nextron
author: Nextron Team <team@example.com>
description: Production Desktop Application built with Next.js 16 and Electron

scripts.dev: node scripts/sync-config.mjs && concurrently -k "next dev --webpack" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:3000 && electron ."
scripts.build: node scripts/sync-config.mjs && npm run build:electron && next build
scripts.creator: npm run init:app
scripts.creator:dev: npm run creator:prepare && npm --prefix creator-app run start
scripts.make:creator: npm run creator:prepare && npm --prefix creator-app run make
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['out', '.next'].forEach(p => { try { fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch {} }); console.log('Clean complete');"
scripts.prepackage: node scripts/sync-config.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.package: npm run prepackage && npm run build && electron-forge package
scripts.make: npm run prepackage && npm run build && electron-forge make
scripts.publish: npm run prepackage && npm run build && electron-forge publish
